in_sanskrit.name: दिव्यंशय
in_sanskrit.meaning: दिव्य (Divy) - divine, अंश (Ansh) - grace, हय (Hay) - horse
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has divine grace and the power of a horse.

in_hindi.name: दिव्यंश
in_hindi.meaning: दिव्य (Divy) - दिव्यता (divine), अंश (Ansh) - अनुपमा (grace), ह (H) - हाथ (hand), य (Y) - यहुः (Yahu) - ईश्वर (Ishvar) - God
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has the divine grace of God in his hand.

in_tamil.name: திவ்யங்சய
in_tamil.meaning: திவ்யம் (Divyam) - divine, ங்சயம் (Ansham) - grace, ய (Y) - ஹாய் (Hay) - ஹோர் (horse)
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has the divine grace of a horse.

in_telugu.name: దివ్యంశ
in_telugu.meaning: దివ్య (Divy) - divine, ఆశ (Ansh) - grace, య (Y) - హాయ (Hay) - ఆశ్చ (Aashcha) - horse
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has the divine grace of a horse.

in_marathi.name: Divyanshay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divyanshay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divyanshay is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'divya' meaning divine and 'ansh' meaning auspicious or part. This name symbolizes the divine presence in an individual.
